nodes.label: Codigo IBGE (7-digit municipality key)
nodes.rationale: Common join key across all sources, allowing values from different sources to be summed, compared and divided per municipality. Exceptions: SIGA (text municipality), P&D ANEEL and SAMP (distributor only), DEC/FEC (electrical set, bridged by INDQUAL).

nodes.label: SICONFI Funcao 19 (Ciencia e Tecnologia)
nodes.rationale: Official budget classification (Portaria MOG 42/1999); only 8 of 415 Bahia municipalities spent on it in 2024 and Salvador accounts for about 95%. Must be used as whole function because DCA groups small subfunctions into 'Demais Subfunções'.

nodes.label: BNDES CT&I rule (innovation flag, instrument list, FUNTTEL/FUST/FNDCT)
nodes.norm_label: bndes ct&i rule (innovation flag, instrument list, funttel/fust/fndct)
nodes.rationale: The innovation flag alone is insufficient since FUST and Difusores de Tecnologia come flagged NAO; Mais Inovação is mostly machine purchase and should be separated from P&D.

nodes.label: ANATEL 4G mobile coverage spreadsheet (Bahia municipalities)
nodes.rationale: One row per Bahia municipality, operator 'Todas', technology 4G; columns: Codigo Municipio, Municipio, UF, Regiao, Operadora, Tecnologia, % area coberta, % moradores cobertos, % domicilios cobertos, Area km2, Moradores, Domicilios.

nodes.label: ANATEL (connectivity and digital infrastructure)
nodes.rationale: Enabling condition for startups, rural connectivity, remote work, digital teaching and cloud public services; no CT&I variable.

nodes.label: ANATEL fixed broadband (SCM): density and accesses
nodes.norm_label: anatel fixed broadband (scm): density and accesses
nodes.rationale: Density series is empty in 2023-2024, only December in 2025, and wrong from Dec/2025 to Mar/2026; use from Apr/2026.

nodes.label: ANATEL 4G mobile coverage (SMP) dataset

nodes.label: DCA Anexo I-E (expenditure by function)
